setup.title: Store Setup Wizard
setup.subtitle: Let's get your store configured in just a few steps

welcome.heading: Welcome! 🎉
welcome.description: We're excited to help you set up your online store. This wizard will guide you through configuring payments, shipping, invoicing, and customizing your storefront.
welcome.videoDesc: Watch this 5-minute tutorial to understand the setup process

store.title: Store Information
store.subtitle: Let's start with your store name
store.nameHelp: This will appear on your storefront and in customer communications
store.footerNote: Once you add your store name, you can configure other settings anytime from the dashboard

payment.title: Payment Setup
payment.subtitle: Configure Netopia for card payments
payment.intro: To accept card payments, create a Netopia merchant account and add these credentials in Store Settings → Payment Provider:
payment.step1Prefix: Create and activate an account at
payment.step3: POS Signature (required) — Admin → Point of Sale → Technical Settings
payment.step4: Public Key (optional) — same Technical Settings page; used for IPN verification
payment.step5: Choose Sandbox for testing or Live for production (keys are environment-specific)

shipping.title: Shipping Setup
shipping.subtitle: Configure eAWB.ro for shipping
shipping.intro: eAWB.ro provides integrated shipping with multiple carriers. Here's how to set it up:
shipping.step2: Get your API key from your account settings
shipping.step3: Configure your billing address and default carrier
shipping.step4: Add credentials in Store Settings → Shipping Provider

invoicing.title: Invoicing Setup
invoicing.subtitle: Configure Oblio.eu for automatic invoicing
invoicing.intro: Oblio.eu automates invoice generation for your orders. Setup steps:
invoicing.step2: Get your API key from account settings
invoicing.step3: Configure your invoice series name and first number
invoicing.step4: Add credentials in Store Settings → Invoicing Provider
